+    "## How rows are counted\n",
+    "\n",
+    "Each row is one finished attack. Time spent is `session_seconds`. The time limit is 300 seconds. A session counts as a timeout when it reached 300 seconds, or when `reason` is a session timeout. Idle timeouts of 60 seconds stay in the plots.\n",
+    "\n",
+    "Unique IP plots keep one row per address: the earliest timestamp. That point stays in the configuration of the first attack. An IP whose first attack hit the time limit is left out of the excluding-timeouts plot, and a later attack from that IP is not substituted.\n"
+   ]

+   "source": [
+    "# one row is one finished attack. time spent is session_seconds\n",
+    "df[\"timestamp\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"timestamp\"])\n",
+    "df[\"session_seconds\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"session_seconds\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
+    "df[\"commands\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"commands\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
+    "df[\"config\"] = df[\"config\"].astype(str).str.replace(r\"\\.0$\", \"\", regex=True)\n",
+    "df = df.dropna(subset=[\"session_seconds\"])\n",
+    "df = df[df[\"config\"].isin([\"1\", \"2\", \"3\", \"4\", \"5\"])].copy()\n",
+    "\n",
+    "LABELS = {\n",
+    "    \"1\": \"1 control\",\n",
+    "    \"2\": \"2 25% ascii\",\n",
+    "    \"3\": \"3 50% ascii\",\n",
+    "    \"4\": \"4 75% ascii\",\n",
+    "    \"5\": \"5 100% ascii\",\n",
+    "}\n",
+    "ORDER = list(LABELS.values())\n",
+    "TIME_LIMIT = 300\n",
+    "TIMEOUT_REASONS = {\"session timeout\", \"kicked at 5 minutes\", \"timeout\"}\n",
+    "SIGNIFICANCE = 0.1\n",
+    "NORMAL_ALPHA = 0.05\n",
+    "\n",
+    "df[\"config_label\"] = df[\"config\"].map(LABELS)\n",
+    "df[\"hit_time_limit\"] = (df[\"session_seconds\"] >= TIME_LIMIT) | (\n",
+    "    df[\"reason\"].fillna(\"\").str.strip().str.lower().isin(TIMEOUT_REASONS)\n",
+    ")\n",
+    "\n",
+    "# timeouts are the 5 minute kick. idle timeouts of 60 seconds stay in the data\n",
+    "kept = df[~df[\"hit_time_limit\"]].copy()\n",
+    "\n",
+    "# one row per ip: the earliest attack, kept in that attack's configuration\n",
+    "known = df[df[\"attacker_ip\"].fillna(\"\").ne(\"\") & df[\"attacker_ip\"].ne(\"unknown\")].copy()\n",
+    "first = known.sort_values(\"timestamp\").drop_duplicates(\"attacker_ip\", keep=\"first\")\n",
+    "first_kept = first[~first[\"hit_time_limit\"]].copy()\n",
+    "\n",
+    "pd.set_option(\"display.max_rows\", 200)\n",
+    "print(f\"attacks: {len(df)}\")\n",
+    "print(f\"unique ips: {df['attacker_ip'].nunique()}\")\n",
+    "print(f\"hit the 5 minute limit: {int(df['hit_time_limit'].sum())}\")\n",
+    "print(f\"attacks excluding the time limit: {len(kept)}\")\n",
+    "print(f\"first attacks: {len(first)}\")\n",
+    "print(f\"first attacks excluding the time limit: {len(first_kept)}\")\n",
+    "df.head()\n"
+   ]
+  },

+    "  - Example: `px.violin(...)`\n",

+    "  - Example: `fig_ex = px.violin(...)`\n",
+    "  - Here, \"fig_ex\" is the name of the violin plot\n",
+    "- Ensure that you are creating violin plots with boxes\n",
+    "  - You can use `box=True` as one of the arguments when making violin plots\n",
+    "- You can use `show()` to display your violin plots\n",
+    "  - Example: `fig.show()`"

+   "execution_count": 50,
+   "metadata": {},
+   "outputs": [],
+   "source": [
+    "# violin with a box, plus median and quartile summary\n",
+    "def make_violin(frame, y_col, title, y_label):\n",
+    "    plot_df = frame[frame[\"config_label\"].isin(ORDER)].copy()\n",
+    "    fig = px.violin(\n",
+    "        plot_df,\n",
+    "        x=\"config_label\",\n",
+    "        y=y_col,\n",
+    "        category_orders={\"config_label\": ORDER},\n",
+    "        box=True,\n",
+    "        points=False,\n",
+    "        title=title,\n",
+    "        labels={\"config_label\": \"honeypot configuration\", y_col: y_label},\n",
+    "    )\n",
+    "    fig.update_layout(width=900, height=520)\n",
+    "    fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=-15)\n",
+    "    fig.update_traces(spanmode=\"hard\")\n",
+    "    return fig, plot_df\n",
+    "\n",
+    "\n",
+    "def print_summary(plot_df, y_col, duration=False):\n",
+    "    rows = []\n",
+    "    for label in ORDER:\n",
+    "        group = plot_df.loc[plot_df[\"config_label\"] == label, y_col]\n",
+    "        if group.empty:\n",
+    "            print(f\"  {label}: n=0\")\n",
+    "            continue\n",
+    "        median = float(group.median())\n",
+    "        row = {\n",
+    "            \"configuration\": label,\n",
+    "            \"n\": int(len(group)),\n",
+    "            \"median\": round(median, 1),\n",
+    "            \"q1\": round(float(group.quantile(0.25)), 1),\n",
+    "            \"q3\": round(float(group.quantile(0.75)), 1),\n",
+    "            \"max\": round(float(group.max()), 1),\n",
+    "        }\n",
+    "        rows.append(row)\n",
+    "        print(\n",
+    "            f\"  {label}: n={row['n']} median={row['median']} \"\n",
+    "            f\"q1={row['q1']} q3={row['q3']} max={row['max']}\"\n",
+    "        )\n",
+    "    summary = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
+    "    display(summary)\n",
+    "    if duration and len(rows) >= 2:\n",
+    "        spread = summary[\"median\"].max() - summary[\"median\"].min()\n",
+    "        print(f\"median spread across configurations: {spread:.0f}s\")\n",
+    "        if spread <= 15:\n",
+    "            print(\"observation: median durations are similar across configurations.\")\n",
+    "        else:\n",
+    "            print(\"observation: median duration differs by configuration. compare the printed medians.\")\n",
+    "    return summary\n"
+   ]
+  },

+  {
+   "cell_type": "markdown",
+   "metadata": {},
+   "source": [
+    "## Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests\n",
+    "\n",
+    "Each configuration is compared with `sp.stats.kstest` to a normal distribution that has that group's own mean and standard deviation. A group counts as normal when the p-value is at least 0.05. If any configuration fails, the later group comparison uses Kruskal-Wallis.\n",
+    "\n",
+    "Group tests in the next section use 0.1 as the significance level, which is the cutoff named in the template.\n"
+   ]
+  },
+  {
+   "cell_type": "code",
+   "execution_count": 57,
+   "metadata": {},
+   "outputs": [],
+   "source": [
+    "def ks_table(frame, y_col, show=True):\n",
+    "    rows = []\n",
+    "    for label in ORDER:\n",
+    "        values = frame.loc[frame[\"config_label\"] == label, y_col].dropna()\n",
+    "        n = int(len(values))\n",
+    "        std = float(values.std(ddof=1)) if n > 1 else 0.0\n",
+    "        if n < 3 or std == 0:\n",
+    "            rows.append({\n",
+    "                \"configuration\": label,\n",
+    "                \"n\": n,\n",
+    "                \"ks_stat\": None,\n",
+    "                \"p_value\": None,\n",
+    "                \"normal_at_0.05\": False,\n",
+    "            })\n",
+    "            continue\n",
+    "        stat, p = sp.stats.kstest(values, \"norm\", args=(float(values.mean()), std))\n",
+    "        rows.append({\n",
+    "            \"configuration\": label,\n",
+    "            \"n\": n,\n",
+    "            \"ks_stat\": round(float(stat), 4),\n",
+    "            \"p_value\": float(p),\n",
+    "            \"normal_at_0.05\": bool(p >= NORMAL_ALPHA),\n",
+    "        })\n",
+    "    table = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
+    "    if show:\n",
+    "        display(table)\n",
+    "    if bool(table[\"normal_at_0.05\"].all()):\n",
+    "        print(\"every configuration is consistent with a normal distribution, so the group test is anova\")\n",
+    "    else:\n",
+    "        print(\"at least one configuration is not normal, so the group test is kruskal-wallis\")\n",
+    "    return table\n"
+   ]
+  },

+    "***\n",
+    "# Statistical Tests\n",
+    "You will need to conduct some statistical tests on your data. Consider refering to class slides and the statistics homework colab if you need a refresher on any of the tests. You are welcome to add additional markdown/code blocks!\n",
+    "\n",
+    "### **Required Analyses**\n",
+    "You will need to conduct tests on the following:\n",
+    "- Time spent (excluding timeouts) per configuration\n",
+    "- Time spent (unique IPs, excluding timeouts) per configuration\n",
+    "- Number of commands per configuration\n",
+    "- Number of commands (unique IPs) per configuration\n",
+    "\n",
+    "_You are welcome to analyze additional data sets as you see fit. Incorrect/misleading analyses may result in a penalty._\n",
+    "\n",
+    "### **Please use the following modules to perform the statistical tests:**\n",
+    "\n",
+    "ANOVA - use `anova_lm()` from `statsmodels.api.stats` (fancy ANOVA)\n",
+    "  - If you did not modify the imports, the command should be `sm.stats.anova_lm(...)`\n",
+    "\n",
+    "TUKEY HSD - use `pairwise_tukeyhsd()`\n",
+    "  - You only need to run a Tukey HSD test if ANOVA is significant (p-value < 0.1)\n",
+    "  - Consider using an if statement!\n",
+    "\n",
+    "KRUSKAL-WALLIS - use `kruskal()` from `scipy.stats`\n",
+    "  - If you did not modify the imports, the command should be `sp.stats.kruskal(...)`\n",
+    "\n",
+    "DUNN - use `posthoc_dunn()` from `scikit_posthocs`\n",
+    "  - You only need to run a Dunn test if Kruskal-Wallis is significant (p-value < 0.1)\n",
+    "  - If you did not modify the imports, the command should be `spkh.posthoc_dunn(...)`\n",
+    "\n",
+    "CHI SQUARED - use `chisquare()` from `scipy.stats`\n",
+    "- If you did not modify the imports, the command should be `sp.stats.chisquare(...)`\n",
+    "### **Remember that the documentation for all of these libraries and modules can be easily found online!**\n",
+    "Suggestions:\n",
+    "- Each test you conduct should be in its own code block\n",
+    "- Group tests together based on type (i.e. all ANOVA tests should be together, etc.)"
+   ]
+  },
+  {
+   "cell_type": "markdown",
+   "metadata": {},
+   "source": [
+    "## Group comparisons\n",
+    "\n",
+    "ANOVA and Tukey HSD run when every configuration passed the normality check. Otherwise the comparison is Kruskal-Wallis, and Dunn's test runs when that p-value is below 0.1. Tukey and Dunn are skipped when the main test is not significant at 0.1.\n"
+   ]
+  },
+  {
+   "cell_type": "code",
+   "execution_count": 62,
+   "metadata": {},
+   "outputs": [],
+   "source": [
+    "def run_group_test(frame, y_col):\n",
+    "    plot_df = frame[frame[\"config_label\"].isin(ORDER)].dropna(subset=[y_col]).copy()\n",
+    "    table = ks_table(plot_df, y_col, show=False)\n",
+    "    labels = [label for label in ORDER if (plot_df[\"config_label\"] == label).any()]\n",
+    "    samples = [plot_df.loc[plot_df[\"config_label\"] == label, y_col] for label in labels]\n",
+    "    if bool(table[\"normal_at_0.05\"].all()):\n",
+    "        model = ols(f\"{y_col} ~ C(config_label)\", data=plot_df).fit()\n",
+    "        anova = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)\n",
+    "        display(anova)\n",
+    "        p = float(anova.loc[\"C(config_label)\", \"PR(>F)\"])\n",
+    "        print(f\"anova p-value: {p:.4g}\")\n",
+    "        if p < SIGNIFICANCE:\n",
+    "            print(pairwise_tukeyhsd(plot_df[y_col], plot_df[\"config_label\"], alpha=SIGNIFICANCE))\n",
+    "        else:\n",
+    "            print(\"anova p-value is at least 0.1, so tukey hsd is not run\")\n",
+    "    else:\n",
+    "        result = sp.stats.kruskal(*samples)\n",
+    "        print(result)\n",
+    "        if result.pvalue < SIGNIFICANCE:\n",
+    "            dunn = skph.posthoc_dunn(\n",
+    "                plot_df,\n",
+    "                val_col=y_col,\n",
+    "                group_col=\"config_label\",\n",
+    "                p_adjust=\"bonferroni\",\n",
+    "            )\n",
+    "            display(dunn.reindex(index=labels, columns=labels))\n",
+    "        else:\n",
+    "            print(\"kruskal-wallis p-value is at least 0.1, so dunn is not run\")\n",
+    "    return table\n"
+   ]
+  },
+  {
+   "cell_type": "markdown",
+   "metadata": {},
+   "source": [

+    "def show_violin(frame, title):\n",
+    "    plot_df = frame[frame[\"config_label\"].isin(ORDER)].copy()\n",
+    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
+    "    sns.violinplot(\n",
+    "        data=plot_df,\n",
+    "        x=\"config_label\",\n",
+    "        y=\"session_seconds\",\n",
+    "        order=ORDER,\n",
+    "        inner=\"box\",\n",
+    "        cut=0,\n",
+    "        ax=ax,\n",
+    "    )\n",
+    "    ax.set_title(title)\n",
+    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"honeypot configuration\")\n",
+    "    ax.set_ylabel(\"attack duration (seconds)\")\n",
+    "    plt.xticks(rotation=15)\n",
+    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
+    "    plt.show()\n",
+    "\n",
+    "    print(title)\n",
+    "    medians = []\n",
+    "    rows = []\n",
+    "    for label in ORDER:\n",
+    "        group = plot_df.loc[plot_df[\"config_label\"] == label, \"session_seconds\"]\n",
+    "        if group.empty:\n",
+    "            print(f\"  {label}: n=0\")\n",
+    "            continue\n",
+    "        median = float(group.median())\n",
+    "        medians.append(median)\n",
+    "        row = {\n",
+    "            \"configuration\": label,\n",
+    "            \"n\": int(len(group)),\n",
+    "            \"median_s\": round(median, 1),\n",
+    "            \"q1_s\": round(float(group.quantile(0.25)), 1),\n",
+    "            \"q3_s\": round(float(group.quantile(0.75)), 1),\n",
+    "            \"max_s\": round(float(group.max()), 1),\n",
+    "        }\n",
+    "        rows.append(row)\n",
+    "        print(\n",
+    "            f\"  {label}: n={row['n']} median={row['median_s']}s \"\n",
+    "            f\"q1={row['q1_s']}s q3={row['q3_s']}s max={row['max_s']}s\"\n",
+    "        )\n",
+    "    display(pd.DataFrame(rows))\n",
+    "    if len(medians) >= 2:\n",
+    "        spread = max(medians) - min(medians)\n",
+    "        print(f\"median spread across configurations: {spread:.0f}s\")\n",
+    "        if spread <= 15:\n",
+    "            print(\"observation: median durations are similar across configurations.\")\n",
+    "        else:\n",
+    "            print(\"observation: median duration differs by configuration. compare the printed medians.\")\n",
+    "    return plot_df\n",
+    "\n",
+    "show_violin(df, \"all attack durations per configuration\")\n"
+   ]
+  },

+#!/bin/bash
+# one loop per honeypot. screen name is the container (hp1).
+# the mitm screen is hp1-mitm, so recycle does not kill this loop.
+# start all four with: ./lifecycle.sh --all
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd "$(dirname "$0")"
+
+# monitor.sh and this loop share /home/aces/data, even when the screen is root
+export HOME=/home/aces
+
+DATA="$HOME/data"
+MITM_CONFIG_DIR=/root/honeypots/MITM/config
+MITM_INDEX=/root/honeypots/MITM/mitm/index.js
+NAT=/root/honeypots/network/nat_mitm
+IDLE_LIMIT="${IDLE_SECONDS:-60}"
+MAX_SESSION="${MAX_SECONDS:-300}"
+
+as_root() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        "$@"
+    else
+        sudo "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+# STY is set inside a screen session. a screen command then quits this loop
+# instead of the mitm session, so every screen command drops STY first.
+screen_do() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        env -u STY screen "$@"
+    else
+        sudo env -u STY screen "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+slack() {
+    local text="$1"
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ] && [ -f "$HOME/data/slack.env" ]
+    then
+        # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+        . "$HOME/data/slack.env"
+    fi
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    text=${text//$'\n'/\\n}
+    curl -sS -m 10 -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
+        --data "{\"text\":\"${text}\"}" \
+        "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" >/dev/null || true
+}
+
+config_now() {
+    local config=unknown
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        config=$(tr -cd '0-9' < "$live/config")
+    fi
+    printf '%s\n' "$config"
+}
+
+# 1 is the empty control. 2 through 5 are the ascii drawings.
+config_text() {
+    case "$(config_now)" in
+        1) printf '%s\n' "1 (control, no ascii)" ;;
+        2) printf '%s\n' "2 (25% ascii)" ;;
+        3) printf '%s\n' "3 (50% ascii)" ;;
+        4) printf '%s\n' "4 (75% ascii)" ;;
+        5) printf '%s\n' "5 (100% ascii)" ;;
+        *) printf '%s\n' "unknown" ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+# logout ends the attack. activity means a shell is open or the attacker typed.
+classify_mitm_line() {
+    case "$1" in
+        *"[Connection] Attacker closed connection"*|*"Attacker ended the shell"*|*"Honeypot ended shell"*|*"OpenSSH server ended connection"*|*"Client error"*)
+            printf '%s\n' logout
+            ;;
+        *"Container locked"*|*"Opened shell"*|*"Shell opened"*|*"shell opened"*|*"inside container"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command"*|*"Attacker Keystroke"*|*"line from reader"*)
+            printf '%s\n' activity
+            ;;
+    esac
+    return 0
+}
+
+# the attacker address is on the connect and auth lines, not the container address
+note_attacker_ip() {
+    local found
+    found=$(printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -oE '([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}' || true)
+    found=${found%%$'\n'*}
+    if [ -z "$found" ] || [ "$found" = "0.0.0.0" ] || [ "$found" = "127.0.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "172.20.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "$PUBLIC_IP" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    case "$found" in
+        172.20.*)
+            return 0
+            ;;
+    esac
+    ATTACKER_IP=$found
+}
+
+lookup() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local line
+    line=$(awk -F, -v n="$name" 'NR > 1 && $1 == n { print; exit }' ./honeypots.csv)
+    if [ -z "$line" ]
+    then
+        echo "unknown honeypot: $name" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    PUBLIC_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
+    MITM_PORT=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
+}
+
+container_ip() {
+    lxc list "$1" -c 4 --format csv 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' || true
+}
+
+session_saved() {
+    [ -s "$live/mitm.log" ] && return 0
+    local d
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+csv_field() {
+    local value="${1//\"/\"\"}"
+    printf '"%s"' "$value"
+}
+
+stats_value() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local stats_file="$2"
+    awk -F= -v key="$key" '
+        $1 == key {
+            sub(/^[^=]*=/, "")
+            print
+            exit
+        }
+    ' "$stats_file"
+}
+
+append_session_csv() {
+    local dest="$1"
+    local stats_file="$dest/session.stats"
+    local session_id honeypot config reason attacker_ip session_seconds commands keystrokes
+    local sessions_csv stamp timestamp
+
+    [ -f "$stats_file" ] || return 0
+    session_id=${dest##*/}
+    honeypot=$(stats_value honeypot "$stats_file")
+    config=$(stats_value config "$stats_file")
+    reason=$(stats_value reason "$stats_file")
+    attacker_ip=$(stats_value attacker_ip "$stats_file")
+    session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$stats_file")
+    # a kick at 300s is measured a few seconds later, so keep that row
+    local limit=$MAX_SESSION
+    if [ "$reason" = "session timeout" ]
+    then
+        limit=$((MAX_SESSION + 30))
+    fi
+    if [[ ! "$session_seconds" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] ||
+        (( 10#$session_seconds > 10#$limit ))
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+
+    commands=$(stats_value commands "$stats_file")
+    keystrokes=$(stats_value keystrokes "$stats_file")
+
+    sessions_csv="$DATA/sessions1.csv"
+    stamp=${session_id%-*}
+    timestamp="${stamp:0:4}-${stamp:4:2}-${stamp:6:2} ${stamp:9:2}:${stamp:11:2}:${stamp:13:2}"
+    {
+        flock -x 9
+        if [ ! -s "$sessions_csv" ]
+        then
+            printf '%s\n' 'timestamp,honeypot,config,attacker_ip,session_seconds,reason,commands,keystrokes' >&9
+        fi
+        {
+            csv_field "$timestamp"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$honeypot"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$config"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$attacker_ip"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$session_seconds"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$reason"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$commands"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$keystrokes"; printf '\n'
+        } >&9
+    } 9>>"$sessions_csv"
+}
+
+archive_session() {
+    local reason="$1" session_seconds
+    local label stamp dest d
+    if ! session_saved
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/session.stats" ]
+    then
+        session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$live/session.stats")
+        local stats_reason limit=$MAX_SESSION
+        stats_reason=$(stats_value reason "$live/session.stats")
+        if [ "$stats_reason" = "session timeout" ]
+        then
+            limit=$((MAX_SESSION + 30))
+        fi
+        if [[ ! "$session_seconds" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
+        then
+            echo "discarding session with invalid duration"
+            return 0
+        fi
+        if (( 10#$session_seconds > 10#$limit ))
+        then
+            echo "discarding session over ${limit}s limit"
+            return 0
+        fi
+    fi
+    case "$reason" in
+        logout) label="attacker left" ;;
+        idle) label="idle timeout" ;;
+        timeout) label="session timeout" ;;
+        *) label="$reason" ;;
+    esac
+    stamp=$(TZ=America/New_York date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
+    dest="$DATA/logs/${stamp}-${name}"
+    mkdir -p "$dest"
+    printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$dest/leave_reason"
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/config" "$dest/config"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/mitm.log" "$dest/mitm.log"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/session.stats" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/session.stats" "$dest/session.stats"
+    fi
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            mkdir -p "$dest/$d"
+            cp -a "$live/$d"/. "$dest/$d/"
+        fi
+    done
+    append_session_csv "$dest"
+    echo "saved $dest ($label)"
+}
+
+clear_session_files() {
+    local d
+    rm -f "$live/mitm.log" "$live/session.stats"
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        rm -rf "$live/$d"
+        mkdir -p "$live/$d"
+    done
+}
+
+sync_mitm_target() {
+    local ip="$1"
+    local cfg="$MITM_CONFIG_DIR/${name}.js"
+    local current
+    if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]
+    then
+        echo "missing $cfg" >&2
+        return 1
+    fi
+    mkdir -p "$live/logins" "$live/login_attempts" "$live/sessions"
+    current=$(as_root grep -oE "ipAddress[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*['\"][0-9.]+" "$cfg" | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$' || true)
+    replace_js_string streamOutput "$live/sessions" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string loginAttempts "$live/login_attempts" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string logins "$live/logins" "$cfg"
+    if [ "$current" != "$ip" ]
+    then
+        replace_js_string ipAddress "$ip" "$cfg"
+        echo "container ip changed to $ip, updating nat"
+        as_root "$NAT" "$PUBLIC_IP" "$ip" "$MITM_PORT"
+    fi
+}
+
+# replace the quoted value of one js key and leave the rest of the line alone
+replace_js_string() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local value="$2"
+    local cfg="$3"
+    local sq="'"
+    local quoted="[${sq}\"][^${sq}\"]*[${sq}\"]"
+    as_root sed -i -E "s|(${key}[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)${quoted}|\\1${sq}${value}${sq}|" "$cfg"
+}
+
+start_mitm() {
+    local _
+    : > "$live/mitm.log"
+    screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    # wait for the old node process to release the port before starting a new one
+    for _ in $(seq 1 20)
+    do
+        if ! ss -ltn "sport = :$MITM_PORT" | grep -q LISTEN
+        then
+            break
+        fi
+        sleep 0.5
+    done
+    screen_do -dmS "${name}-mitm" bash -c "cd '$MITM_CONFIG_DIR' && node '$MITM_INDEX' '${name}.js' 2>&1 | tee -a '$live/mitm.log'"
+}
+
+mitm_listening() {
+    local _
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30)
+    do
+        if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ] && grep -q "listening on" "$live/mitm.log"
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+        sleep 1
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+# sets SESSION_REASON, SESSION_START, SESSION_CONNECTED_AT, SESSION_COMMANDS, SESSION_KEYSTROKES, SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND, ATTACKER_IP
+watch_session() {
+    local logfile="$live/mitm.log"
+    local seen=0 total now line event
+    local in_session=0 start_ts=0 last_ts=0
+    SESSION_REASON=
+    SESSION_START=0
+    SESSION_START=
+    SESSION_COMMANDS=0
+    SESSION_KEYSTROKES=0
+    SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=-1
+    ATTACKER_IP=unknown
+    : >> "$logfile"
+    # 0 when the session must end. idle is 60s of silence. the hard cap is 300s.
+    over_limit() {
+        if [ "$in_session" -ne 1 ]
+        then
+            return 1
+        fi
+        now=$(date +%s)
+        if [ $((now - start_ts)) -ge "$MAX_SESSION" ]
+        then
+            SESSION_REASON=timeout
+            kick_attacker
+            return 0
+        fi
+        if [ $((now - last_ts)) -ge "$IDLE_LIMIT" ]
+        then
+            SESSION_REASON=idle
+            kick_attacker
+            return 0
+        fi
+        return 1
+    }
+    while true
+    do
+        total=$(wc -l < "$logfile" | tr -d '[:space:]')
+        if [ "$total" -gt "$seen" ]
+        then
+            while IFS= read -r line
+            do
+                case "$line" in
+                    *"Attacker connected:"*|*"Container locked to "*|*"trying to authenticate"*|*"[Auth] Attacker:"*|*"Auto Access] Attacker:"*)
+                        note_attacker_ip "$line"
+                        ;;
+                    *"line from reader:"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command:"*)
+                        SESSION_COMMANDS=$((SESSION_COMMANDS + 1))
+                        ;;
+                    *"Attacker Keystroke:"*)
+                        SESSION_KEYSTROKES=$((SESSION_KEYSTROKES + 1))
+                        ;;
+                esac
+                event=$(classify_mitm_line "$line")
+                if [ "$event" = "logout" ]
+                then
+                    # a late disconnect line must not hide a session that already hit the cap
+                    if over_limit
+                    then
+                        return 0
+                    fi
+                    SESSION_REASON=logout
+                    return 0
+                fi
+                if [ "$event" = "activity" ]
+                then
+                    now=$(date +%s)
+                    if [ "$in_session" -eq 0 ]
+                    then
+                        in_session=1
+                        start_ts=$now
+                        SESSION_START=$now
+                        SESSION_START=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+                        echo "session started" >&2
+                    fi
+                    if [ "$SESSION_COMMANDS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -lt 0 ]
+                    then
+                        SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=$((now - start_ts))
+                    fi
+                    last_ts=$now
+                fi
+                if over_limit
+                then
+                    return 0
+                fi
+            done < <(awk -v start=$((seen + 1)) -v end="$total" 'NR >= start && NR <= end' "$logfile")
+            seen=$total
+        fi
+        if over_limit
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+        sleep 2
+    done
+}
+
+# one record per attack, copied into the saved session folder
+write_session_stats() {
+    local length="$1"
+    local why="$2"
+    local first=none
+    if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+    then
+        first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+    fi
+    cat > "$live/session.stats" << EOF
+honeypot=$name
+public_ip=$PUBLIC_IP
+started_at=$SESSION_START
+ended_at=$SESSION_ENDED_AT
+config=$(config_now)
+ascii=$(config_text)
+reason=$why
+attacker_ip=$ATTACKER_IP
+session_seconds=$length
+commands=$SESSION_COMMANDS
+keystrokes=$SESSION_KEYSTROKES
+seconds_to_first_command=$first
+EOF
+}
+
+kick_attacker() {
+    lxc exec "$name" -- pkill sshd || true
+}
+
+run_one() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local live reason ip left_at
+    lookup "$name"
+    live="$DATA/live/$name"
+    mkdir -p "$live"
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        chown aces:aces "$live" || true
+    fi
+    echo "lifecycle $name"
+    # save the finished session before the next restore wipes the container
+    reason=previous
+    while true
+    do
+        if [ -n "$reason" ]
+        then
+            archive_session "$reason"
+        fi
+        clear_session_files
+        if ! ./recycling_script.sh "$name" "${name}-mitm"
+        then
+            echo "recycle failed for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        ip=$(container_ip "$name")
+        if [ -z "$ip" ]
+        then
+            echo "no ip for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        if ! sync_mitm_target "$ip"
+        then
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        start_mitm
+        if ! mitm_listening
+        then
+            echo "mitm for $name did not start, retrying"
+            if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+            then
+                tail -n 20 "$live/mitm.log" >&2
+            fi
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        echo "waiting for attacker on $name"
+        watch_session
+        reason=$SESSION_REASON
+        SESSION_ENDED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+        left_at=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        echo "session ended: $reason"
+        length=0
+        if [ "$SESSION_START" -gt 0 ]
+        then
+            length=$(( $(date +%s) - SESSION_START ))
+        fi
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout) why="attacker left" ;;
+            idle) why="idle timeout" ;;
+            timeout) why="session timeout" ;;
+            *) why=$reason ;;
+        esac
+        first=none
+        if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+        then
+            first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+        fi
+        left=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout|idle|timeout)
+                write_session_stats "$length" "$why"
+                ;;
+        esac
+        case "$reason" in
+            idle|timeout)
+                kick_attacker
+                sleep 1
+                ;;
+            logout)
+                ;;
+            *)
+                echo "watcher stopped, recycling"
+                reason=error
+                ;;
+        esac
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        sleep 1
+    done
+}
+
+start_all() {
+    local root name
+    root=$(pwd)
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        env -u STY screen -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        screen_do -dmS "$name" bash -c "cd '$root' && exec ./run-one.sh '$name'"
+        echo "started $name"
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+}
+
+main() {
+    if [ "${1:-}" = "--all" ]
+    then
+        start_all
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]
+    then
+        echo "usage: $0 <container name> | $0 --all" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    # a failed command must not end the screen. start the honeypot again.
+    while true
+    do
+        (
+            run_one "$1"
+        ) || echo "lifecycle $1 stopped, starting again"
+        sleep 5
+    done
+}
+
+if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]
+then
+    main "$@"
+fi

+#!/bin/bash
+# one loop per honeypot. screen name is the container (hp1).
+# the mitm screen is hp1-mitm, so recycle does not kill this loop.
+# start all four with: ./lifecycle.sh --all
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd "$(dirname "$0")"
+
+# monitor.sh and this loop share /home/aces/data, even when the screen is root
+export HOME=/home/aces
+
+DATA="$HOME/data"
+MITM_CONFIG_DIR=/root/honeypots/MITM/config
+MITM_INDEX=/root/honeypots/MITM/mitm/index.js
+NAT=/root/honeypots/network/nat_mitm
+IDLE_LIMIT="${IDLE_SECONDS:-60}"
+MAX_SESSION="${MAX_SECONDS:-300}"
+
+as_root() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        "$@"
+    else
+        sudo "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+# STY is set inside a screen session. a screen command then quits this loop
+# instead of the mitm session, so every screen command drops STY first.
+screen_do() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        env -u STY screen "$@"
+    else
+        sudo env -u STY screen "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+slack() {
+    local text="$1"
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ] && [ -f "$HOME/data/slack.env" ]
+    then
+        # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+        . "$HOME/data/slack.env"
+    fi
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    text=${text//$'\n'/\\n}
+    curl -sS -m 10 -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
+        --data "{\"text\":\"${text}\"}" \
+        "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" >/dev/null || true
+}
+
+config_now() {
+    local config=unknown
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        config=$(tr -cd '0-9' < "$live/config")
+    fi
+    printf '%s\n' "$config"
+}
+
+# 1 is the empty control. 2 through 5 are the ascii drawings.
+config_text() {
+    case "$(config_now)" in
+        1) printf '%s\n' "1 (control, no ascii)" ;;
+        2) printf '%s\n' "2 (25% ascii)" ;;
+        3) printf '%s\n' "3 (50% ascii)" ;;
+        4) printf '%s\n' "4 (75% ascii)" ;;
+        5) printf '%s\n' "5 (100% ascii)" ;;
+        *) printf '%s\n' "unknown" ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+# logout ends the attack. activity means a shell is open or the attacker typed.
+classify_mitm_line() {
+    case "$1" in
+        *"[Connection] Attacker closed connection"*|*"Attacker ended the shell"*|*"Honeypot ended shell"*|*"OpenSSH server ended connection"*|*"Client error"*)
+            printf '%s\n' logout
+            ;;
+        *"Container locked"*|*"Opened shell"*|*"Shell opened"*|*"shell opened"*|*"inside container"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command"*|*"Attacker Keystroke"*|*"line from reader"*)
+            printf '%s\n' activity
+            ;;
+    esac
+    return 0
+}
+
+# the attacker address is on the connect and auth lines, not the container address
+note_attacker_ip() {
+    local found
+    found=$(printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -oE '([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}' || true)
+    found=${found%%$'\n'*}
+    if [ -z "$found" ] || [ "$found" = "0.0.0.0" ] || [ "$found" = "127.0.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "172.20.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "$PUBLIC_IP" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    case "$found" in
+        172.20.*)
+            return 0
+            ;;
+    esac
+    ATTACKER_IP=$found
+}
+
+lookup() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local line
+    line=$(awk -F, -v n="$name" 'NR > 1 && $1 == n { print; exit }' ./honeypots.csv)
+    if [ -z "$line" ]
+    then
+        echo "unknown honeypot: $name" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    PUBLIC_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
+    MITM_PORT=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
+}
+
+container_ip() {
+    lxc list "$1" -c 4 --format csv 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' || true
+}
+
+session_saved() {
+    [ -s "$live/mitm.log" ] && return 0
+    local d
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+csv_field() {
+    local value="${1//\"/\"\"}"
+    printf '"%s"' "$value"
+}
+
+stats_value() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local stats_file="$2"
+    awk -F= -v key="$key" '
+        $1 == key {
+            sub(/^[^=]*=/, "")
+            print
+            exit
+        }
+    ' "$stats_file"
+}
+
+append_session_csv() {
+    local dest="$1"
+    local stats_file="$dest/session.stats"
+    local session_id honeypot config reason attacker_ip session_seconds commands keystrokes
+    local sessions_csv stamp timestamp
+
+    [ -f "$stats_file" ] || return 0
+    session_id=${dest##*/}
+    honeypot=$(stats_value honeypot "$stats_file")
+    config=$(stats_value config "$stats_file")
+    reason=$(stats_value reason "$stats_file")
+    attacker_ip=$(stats_value attacker_ip "$stats_file")
+    session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$stats_file")
+    # a kick at 300s is measured a few seconds later, so keep that row
+    local limit=$MAX_SESSION
+    if [ "$reason" = "session timeout" ]
+    then
+        limit=$((MAX_SESSION + 30))
+    fi
+    if [[ ! "$session_seconds" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] ||
+        (( 10#$session_seconds > 10#$limit ))
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+
+    commands=$(stats_value commands "$stats_file")
+    keystrokes=$(stats_value keystrokes "$stats_file")
+
+    sessions_csv="$DATA/sessions1.csv"
+    stamp=${session_id%-*}
+    timestamp="${stamp:0:4}-${stamp:4:2}-${stamp:6:2} ${stamp:9:2}:${stamp:11:2}:${stamp:13:2}"
+    {
+        flock -x 9
+        if [ ! -s "$sessions_csv" ]
+        then
+            printf '%s\n' 'timestamp,honeypot,config,attacker_ip,session_seconds,reason,commands,keystrokes' >&9
+        fi
+        {
+            csv_field "$timestamp"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$honeypot"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$config"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$attacker_ip"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$session_seconds"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$reason"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$commands"; printf ','
+            csv_field "$keystrokes"; printf '\n'
+        } >&9
+    } 9>>"$sessions_csv"
+}
+
+archive_session() {
+    local reason="$1" session_seconds
+    local label stamp dest d
+    if ! session_saved
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/session.stats" ]
+    then
+        session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$live/session.stats")
+        local stats_reason limit=$MAX_SESSION
+        stats_reason=$(stats_value reason "$live/session.stats")
+        if [ "$stats_reason" = "session timeout" ]
+        then
+            limit=$((MAX_SESSION + 30))
+        fi
+        if [[ ! "$session_seconds" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
+        then
+            echo "discarding session with invalid duration"
+            return 0
+        fi
+        if (( 10#$session_seconds > 10#$limit ))
+        then
+            echo "discarding session over ${limit}s limit"
+            return 0
+        fi
+    fi
+    case "$reason" in
+        logout) label="attacker left" ;;
+        idle) label="idle timeout" ;;
+        timeout) label="session timeout" ;;
+        *) label="$reason" ;;
+    esac
+    stamp=$(TZ=America/New_York date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
+    dest="$DATA/logs/${stamp}-${name}"
+    mkdir -p "$dest"
+    printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$dest/leave_reason"
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/config" "$dest/config"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/mitm.log" "$dest/mitm.log"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/session.stats" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/session.stats" "$dest/session.stats"
+    fi
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            mkdir -p "$dest/$d"
+            cp -a "$live/$d"/. "$dest/$d/"
+        fi
+    done
+    append_session_csv "$dest"
+    echo "saved $dest ($label)"
+}
+
+clear_session_files() {
+    local d
+    rm -f "$live/mitm.log" "$live/session.stats"
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        rm -rf "$live/$d"
+        mkdir -p "$live/$d"
+    done
+}
+
+sync_mitm_target() {
+    local ip="$1"
+    local cfg="$MITM_CONFIG_DIR/${name}.js"
+    local current
+    if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]
+    then
+        echo "missing $cfg" >&2
+        return 1
+    fi
+    mkdir -p "$live/logins" "$live/login_attempts" "$live/sessions"
+    current=$(as_root grep -oE "ipAddress[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*['\"][0-9.]+" "$cfg" | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$' || true)
+    replace_js_string streamOutput "$live/sessions" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string loginAttempts "$live/login_attempts" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string logins "$live/logins" "$cfg"
+    if [ "$current" != "$ip" ]
+    then
+        replace_js_string ipAddress "$ip" "$cfg"
+        echo "container ip changed to $ip, updating nat"
+        as_root "$NAT" "$PUBLIC_IP" "$ip" "$MITM_PORT"
+    fi
+}
+
+# replace the quoted value of one js key and leave the rest of the line alone
+replace_js_string() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local value="$2"
+    local cfg="$3"
+    local sq="'"
+    local quoted="[${sq}\"][^${sq}\"]*[${sq}\"]"
+    as_root sed -i -E "s|(${key}[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)${quoted}|\\1${sq}${value}${sq}|" "$cfg"
+}
+
+start_mitm() {
+    local _
+    : > "$live/mitm.log"
+    screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    # wait for the old node process to release the port before starting a new one
+    for _ in $(seq 1 20)
+    do
+        if ! ss -ltn "sport = :$MITM_PORT" | grep -q LISTEN
+        then
+            break
+        fi
+        sleep 0.5
+    done
+    screen_do -dmS "${name}-mitm" bash -c "cd '$MITM_CONFIG_DIR' && node '$MITM_INDEX' '${name}.js' 2>&1 | tee -a '$live/mitm.log'"
+}
+
+mitm_listening() {
+    local _
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30)
+    do
+        if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ] && grep -q "listening on" "$live/mitm.log"
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+        sleep 1
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+# sets SESSION_REASON, SESSION_START, SESSION_CONNECTED_AT, SESSION_COMMANDS, SESSION_KEYSTROKES, SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND, ATTACKER_IP
+watch_session() {
+    local logfile="$live/mitm.log"
+    local seen=0 total now line event
+    local in_session=0 start_ts=0 last_ts=0
+    SESSION_REASON=
+    SESSION_START=0
+    SESSION_STARTED_AT=
+    SESSION_COMMANDS=0
+    SESSION_KEYSTROKES=0
+    SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=-1
+    ATTACKER_IP=unknown
+    : >> "$logfile"
+    # 0 when the session must end. idle is 60s of silence. the hard cap is 300s.
+    over_limit() {
+        if [ "$in_session" -ne 1 ]
+        then
+            return 1
+        fi
+        now=$(date +%s)
+        if [ $((now - start_ts)) -ge "$MAX_SESSION" ]
+        then
+            SESSION_REASON=timeout
+            kick_attacker
+            return 0
+        fi
+        if [ $((now - last_ts)) -ge "$IDLE_LIMIT" ]
+        then
+            SESSION_REASON=idle
+            kick_attacker
+            return 0
+        fi
+        return 1
+    }
+    while true
+    do
+        total=$(wc -l < "$logfile" | tr -d '[:space:]')
+        if [ "$total" -gt "$seen" ]
+        then
+            while IFS= read -r line
+            do
+                case "$line" in
+                    *"Attacker connected:"*|*"Container locked to "*|*"trying to authenticate"*|*"[Auth] Attacker:"*|*"Auto Access] Attacker:"*)
+                        note_attacker_ip "$line"
+                        ;;
+                    *"line from reader:"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command:"*)
+                        SESSION_COMMANDS=$((SESSION_COMMANDS + 1))
+                        ;;
+                    *"Attacker Keystroke:"*)
+                        SESSION_KEYSTROKES=$((SESSION_KEYSTROKES + 1))
+                        ;;
+                esac
+                event=$(classify_mitm_line "$line")
+                if [ "$event" = "logout" ]
+                then
+                    # a late disconnect line must not hide a session that already hit the cap
+                    if over_limit
+                    then
+                        return 0
+                    fi
+                    SESSION_REASON=logout
+                    return 0
+                fi
+                if [ "$event" = "activity" ]
+                then
+                    now=$(date +%s)
+                    if [ "$in_session" -eq 0 ]
+                    then
+                        in_session=1
+                        start_ts=$now
+                        SESSION_START=$now
+                        SESSION_STARTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+                        echo "session started" >&2
+                    fi
+                    if [ "$SESSION_COMMANDS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -lt 0 ]
+                    then
+                        SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=$((now - start_ts))
+                    fi
+                    last_ts=$now
+                fi
+                if over_limit
+                then
+                    return 0
+                fi
+            done < <(awk -v start=$((seen + 1)) -v end="$total" 'NR >= start && NR <= end' "$logfile")
+            seen=$total
+        fi
+        if over_limit
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+        sleep 2
+    done
+}
+
+# one record per attack, copied into the saved session folder
+write_session_stats() {
+    local length="$1"
+    local why="$2"
+    local first=none
+    if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+    then
+        first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+    fi
+    cat > "$live/session.stats" << EOF
+honeypot=$name
+public_ip=$PUBLIC_IP
+started_at=$SESSION_STARTED_AT
+ended_at=$SESSION_ENDED_AT
+config=$(config_now)
+ascii=$(config_text)
+reason=$why
+attacker_ip=$ATTACKER_IP
+session_seconds=$length
+commands=$SESSION_COMMANDS
+keystrokes=$SESSION_KEYSTROKES
+seconds_to_first_command=$first
+EOF
+}
+
+kick_attacker() {
+    lxc exec "$name" -- pkill sshd || true
+}
+
+run_one() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local live reason ip left_at
+    lookup "$name"
+    live="$DATA/live/$name"
+    mkdir -p "$live"
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        chown aces:aces "$live" || true
+    fi
+    echo "lifecycle $name"
+    # save the finished session before the next restore wipes the container
+    reason=previous
+    while true
+    do
+        if [ -n "$reason" ]
+        then
+            archive_session "$reason"
+        fi
+        clear_session_files
+        if ! ./recycling_script.sh "$name" "${name}-mitm"
+        then
+            echo "recycle failed for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        ip=$(container_ip "$name")
+        if [ -z "$ip" ]
+        then
+            echo "no ip for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        if ! sync_mitm_target "$ip"
+        then
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        start_mitm
+        if ! mitm_listening
+        then
+            echo "mitm for $name did not start, retrying"
+            if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+            then
+                tail -n 20 "$live/mitm.log" >&2
+            fi
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        echo "waiting for attacker on $name"
+        watch_session
+        reason=$SESSION_REASON
+        SESSION_ENDED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+        left_at=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        echo "session ended: $reason"
+        length=0
+        if [ "$SESSION_START" -gt 0 ]
+        then
+            length=$(( $(date +%s) - SESSION_START ))
+        fi
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout) why="attacker left" ;;
+            idle) why="idle timeout" ;;
+            timeout) why="session timeout" ;;
+            *) why=$reason ;;
+        esac
+        first=none
+        if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+        then
+            first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+        fi
+        left=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout|idle|timeout)
+                write_session_stats "$length" "$why"
+                ;;
+        esac
+        case "$reason" in
+            idle|timeout)
+                kick_attacker
+                sleep 1
+                ;;
+            logout)
+                ;;
+            *)
+                echo "watcher stopped, recycling"
+                reason=error
+                ;;
+        esac
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        sleep 1
+    done
+}
+
+start_all() {
+    local root name
+    root=$(pwd)
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        env -u STY screen -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        screen_do -dmS "$name" bash -c "cd '$root' && exec ./run-one.sh '$name'"
+        echo "started $name"
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+}
+
+main() {
+    if [ "${1:-}" = "--all" ]
+    then
+        start_all
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]
+    then
+        echo "usage: $0 <container name> | $0 --all" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    # a failed command must not end the screen. start the honeypot again.
+    while true
+    do
+        (
+            run_one "$1"
+        ) || echo "lifecycle $1 stopped, starting again"
+        sleep 5
+    done
+}
+
+if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]
+then
+    main "$@"
+fi

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# copy watch_session and the leave-reason labels from a fixed lifecycle.sh
+# into the copy that is running on the vm.
+# usage: python3 apply_watch_fix.py /tmp/lifecycle.mac.sh lifecycle.sh
+
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def function_span(text, name):
+    match = re.search(rf"^{name}\(\) \{{", text, re.M)
+    if match is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"missing {name}()")
+    start = match.start()
+    depth = 0
+    for index in range(match.end() - 1, len(text)):
+        char = text[index]
+        if char == "{":
+            depth += 1
+        elif char == "}":
+            depth -= 1
+            if depth == 0:
+                return start, index + 1
+    raise SystemExit(f"no closing brace for {name}")
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: apply_watch_fix.py <new lifecycle.sh> <vm lifecycle.sh>")
+    src = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
+    dest_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
+    dest = dest_path.read_text()
+    dest_path.with_suffix(".sh.before-limit").write_text(dest)
+    start, end = function_span(src, "watch_session")
+    old_start, old_end = function_span(dest, "watch_session")
+    dest = dest[:old_start] + src[start:end] + dest[old_end:]
+    dest = re.sub(r'logout\) why=.*', 'logout) why="attacker left" ;;', dest, count=1)
+    dest = re.sub(r'idle\) why=.*', 'idle) why="idle timeout" ;;', dest, count=1)
+    dest = re.sub(r'timeout\) why=.*', 'timeout) why="session timeout" ;;', dest, count=1)
+    dest_path.write_text(dest)
+    print(f"updated {dest_path}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# one row per saved session, for the standup notebook.
+# writes /home/aces/data/sessions.csv
+
+import csv
+import os
+import pwd
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DATA = Path(os.environ.get("HONEYPOT_DATA", "/home/aces/data"))
+LOGS = DATA / "logs"
+OUT = DATA / "sessions.csv"
+FIELDS = [
+    "timestamp",
+    "honeypot",
+    "config",
+    "attacker_ip",
+    "session_seconds",
+    "reason",
+    "commands",
+    "keystrokes",
+]
+
+
+def folder_time(name):
+    # 20261028T175632-hp1 is eastern. a trailing z on the stamp is utc.
+    stamp, hp = name.rsplit("-", 1)
+    utc = stamp.endswith("Z")
+    stamp = stamp[:-1] if utc else stamp
+    dt = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
+    if utc:
+        epoch = (dt - datetime(1970, 1, 1)).total_seconds()
+        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(epoch)
+    return dt, hp
+
+
+def parse_stats(path):
+    info = {}
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return info
+    for raw in path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
+        if "=" not in raw:
+            continue
+        key, value = raw.split("=", 1)
+        info[key.strip()] = value.strip()
+    return info
+
+
+def main():
+    rows = []
+    if not LOGS.is_dir():
+        raise SystemExit(f"missing {LOGS}")
+    for folder in sorted(LOGS.iterdir()):
+        if not re.match(r"\d{8}T\d{6}Z?-", folder.name):
+            continue
+        try:
+            when, hp = folder_time(folder.name)
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        stats = parse_stats(folder / "session.stats")
+        seconds = stats.get("session_seconds", "")
+        if not seconds.isdigit():
+            continue
+        rows.append({
+            "timestamp": when.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
+            "honeypot": stats.get("honeypot", hp),
+            "config": stats.get("config", ""),
+            "attacker_ip": stats.get("attacker_ip", ""),
+            "session_seconds": seconds,
+            "reason": stats.get("reason", ""),
+            "commands": stats.get("commands", ""),
+            "keystrokes": stats.get("keystrokes", ""),
+        })
+    with OUT.open("w", newline="") as handle:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=FIELDS)
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+    if hasattr(os, "geteuid") and os.geteuid() == 0:
+        user = pwd.getpwnam("aces")
+        os.chown(OUT, user.pw_uid, user.pw_gid)
+    print(f"wrote {len(rows)} sessions to {OUT}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/bin/bash
+# one loop per honeypot. screen name is the container (hp1).
+# the mitm screen is hp1-mitm, so recycle does not kill this loop.
+# start all four with: ./lifecycle.sh --all
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd "$(dirname "$0")"
+
+# monitor.sh and this loop share /home/aces/data, even when the screen is root
+export HOME=/home/aces
+
+DATA="$HOME/data"
+MITM_CONFIG_DIR=/root/honeypots/MITM/config
+MITM_INDEX=/root/honeypots/MITM/mitm/index.js
+NAT=/root/honeypots/network/nat_mitm
+IDLE_LIMIT="${IDLE_SECONDS:-60}"
+MAX_SESSION="${MAX_SECONDS:-300}"
+
+as_root() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        "$@"
+    else
+        sudo "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+# STY is set inside a screen session. a screen command then quits this loop
+# instead of the mitm session, so every screen command drops STY first.
+screen_do() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        env -u STY screen "$@"
+    else
+        sudo env -u STY screen "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+slack() {
+    local text="$1"
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ] && [ -f "$HOME/data/slack.env" ]
+    then
+        # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+        . "$HOME/data/slack.env"
+    fi
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    text=${text//$'\n'/\\n}
+    curl -sS -m 10 -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
+        --data "{\"text\":\"${text}\"}" \
+        "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" >/dev/null || true
+}
+
+config_now() {
+    local config=unknown
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        config=$(tr -cd '0-9' < "$live/config")
+    fi
+    printf '%s\n' "$config"
+}
+
+# 1 is the empty control. 2 through 5 are the ascii drawings.
+config_text() {
+    case "$(config_now)" in
+        1) printf '%s\n' "1 (control, no ascii)" ;;
+        2) printf '%s\n' "2 (25% ascii)" ;;
+        3) printf '%s\n' "3 (50% ascii)" ;;
+        4) printf '%s\n' "4 (75% ascii)" ;;
+        5) printf '%s\n' "5 (100% ascii)" ;;
+        *) printf '%s\n' "unknown" ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+# logout ends the attack. activity means a shell is open or the attacker typed.
+classify_mitm_line() {
+    case "$1" in
+        *"[Connection] Attacker closed connection"*|*"Attacker ended the shell"*|*"Honeypot ended shell"*|*"OpenSSH server ended connection"*|*"Client error"*)
+            printf '%s\n' logout
+            ;;
+        *"Container locked"*|*"Opened shell"*|*"Shell opened"*|*"shell opened"*|*"inside container"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command"*|*"Attacker Keystroke"*|*"line from reader"*)
+            printf '%s\n' activity
+            ;;
+    esac
+    return 0
+}
+
+# the attacker address is on the connect and auth lines, not the container address
+note_attacker_ip() {
+    local found
+    found=$(printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -oE '([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}' || true)
+    found=${found%%$'\n'*}
+    if [ -z "$found" ] || [ "$found" = "0.0.0.0" ] || [ "$found" = "127.0.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "172.20.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "$PUBLIC_IP" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    case "$found" in
+        172.20.*)
+            return 0
+            ;;
+    esac
+    ATTACKER_IP=$found
+}
+
+lookup() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local line
+    line=$(awk -F, -v n="$name" 'NR > 1 && $1 == n { print; exit }' ./honeypots.csv)
+    if [ -z "$line" ]
+    then
+        echo "unknown honeypot: $name" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    PUBLIC_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
+    MITM_PORT=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
+}
+
+container_ip() {
+    lxc list "$1" -c 4 --format csv 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' || true
+}
+
+session_saved() {
+    [ -s "$live/mitm.log" ] && return 0
+    local d
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+csv_field() {
+    local value="${1//\"/\"\"}"
+    printf '"%s"' "$value"
+}
+
+stats_value() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local stats_file="$2"
+    awk -F= -v key="$key" '
+        $1 == key {
+            sub(/^[^=]*=/, "")
+            print
+            exit
+        }
+    ' "$stats_file"
+}
+
+append_session_csv() {
+    local dest="$1"
+    local stats_file="$dest/session.stats"
+    local csv="$DATA/${name}.lifecycle.csv"
+    local session_id started_at ended_at honeypot public_ip config ascii reason
+    local attacker_ip session_seconds commands keystrokes first_command
+
+    [ -f "$stats_file" ] || return 0
+    session_id=${dest##*/}
+    started_at=$(stats_value started_at "$stats_file")
+    ended_at=$(stats_value ended_at "$stats_file")
+    # Older archived stats do not include timestamps and cannot form a full row.
+    [ -n "$started_at" ] && [ -n "$ended_at" ] || return 0
+
+    if [ -s "$csv" ] && awk -F, -v id="$session_id" '
+        NR > 1 && ($1 == id || $1 == "\"" id "\"") { found = 1 }
+        END { exit !found }
+    ' "$csv"
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+
+    if [ ! -s "$csv" ]
+    then
+        printf '%s\n' 'session_id,honeypot,started_at,ended_at,session_status,public_ip,config,ascii,reason,attacker_ip,session_seconds,commands,keystrokes,seconds_to_first_command' > "$csv"
+    fi
+
+    honeypot=$(stats_value honeypot "$stats_file")
+    public_ip=$(stats_value public_ip "$stats_file")
+    config=$(stats_value config "$stats_file")
+    ascii=$(stats_value ascii "$stats_file")
+    reason=$(stats_value reason "$stats_file")
+    attacker_ip=$(stats_value attacker_ip "$stats_file")
+    session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$stats_file")
+    commands=$(stats_value commands "$stats_file")
+    keystrokes=$(stats_value keystrokes "$stats_file")
+    first_command=$(stats_value seconds_to_first_command "$stats_file")
+    first_command=${first_command%s}
+    [ "$first_command" != none ] || first_command=
+
+    {
+        csv_field "$session_id"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$honeypot"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$started_at"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$ended_at"; printf ','
+        csv_field completed; printf ','
+        csv_field "$public_ip"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$config"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$ascii"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$reason"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$attacker_ip"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$session_seconds"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$commands"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$keystrokes"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$first_command"; printf '\n'
+    } >> "$csv"
+}
+
+archive_session() {
+    local reason="$1"
+    local label stamp dest d
+    if ! session_saved
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    case "$reason" in
+        logout) label="attacker left" ;;
+        idle) label="idle timeout" ;;
+        timeout) label="session timeout" ;;
+        *) label="$reason" ;;
+    esac
+    stamp=$(TZ=America/New_York date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
+    dest="$DATA/logs/${stamp}-${name}"
+    mkdir -p "$dest"
+    printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$dest/leave_reason"
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/config" "$dest/config"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/mitm.log" "$dest/mitm.log"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/session.stats" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/session.stats" "$dest/session.stats"
+    fi
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            mkdir -p "$dest/$d"
+            cp -a "$live/$d"/. "$dest/$d/"
+        fi
+    done
+    append_session_csv "$dest"
+    echo "saved $dest ($label)"
+}
+
+clear_session_files() {
+    local d
+    rm -f "$live/mitm.log" "$live/session.stats"
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        rm -rf "$live/$d"
+        mkdir -p "$live/$d"
+    done
+}
+
+sync_mitm_target() {
+    local ip="$1"
+    local cfg="$MITM_CONFIG_DIR/${name}.js"
+    local current
+    if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]
+    then
+        echo "missing $cfg" >&2
+        return 1
+    fi
+    mkdir -p "$live/logins" "$live/login_attempts" "$live/sessions"
+    current=$(as_root grep -oE "ipAddress[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*['\"][0-9.]+" "$cfg" | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$' || true)
+    replace_js_string streamOutput "$live/sessions" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string loginAttempts "$live/login_attempts" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string logins "$live/logins" "$cfg"
+    if [ "$current" != "$ip" ]
+    then
+        replace_js_string ipAddress "$ip" "$cfg"
+        echo "container ip changed to $ip, updating nat"
+        as_root "$NAT" "$PUBLIC_IP" "$ip" "$MITM_PORT"
+    fi
+}
+
+# replace the quoted value of one js key and leave the rest of the line alone
+replace_js_string() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local value="$2"
+    local cfg="$3"
+    local sq="'"
+    local quoted="[${sq}\"][^${sq}\"]*[${sq}\"]"
+    as_root sed -i -E "s|(${key}[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)${quoted}|\\1${sq}${value}${sq}|" "$cfg"
+}
+
+start_mitm() {
+    local _
+    : > "$live/mitm.log"
+    screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    # wait for the old node process to release the port before starting a new one
+    for _ in $(seq 1 20)
+    do
+        if ! ss -ltn "sport = :$MITM_PORT" | grep -q LISTEN
+        then
+            break
+        fi
+        sleep 0.5
+    done
+    screen_do -dmS "${name}-mitm" bash -c "cd '$MITM_CONFIG_DIR' && node '$MITM_INDEX' '${name}.js' 2>&1 | tee -a '$live/mitm.log'"
+}
+
+mitm_listening() {
+    local _
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30)
+    do
+        if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ] && grep -q "listening on" "$live/mitm.log"
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+        sleep 1
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+# sets SESSION_REASON, SESSION_START, SESSION_CONNECTED_AT, SESSION_COMMANDS, SESSION_KEYSTROKES, SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND, ATTACKER_IP
+watch_session() {
+    local logfile="$live/mitm.log"
+    local seen=0 total now line event
+    local in_session=0 start_ts=0 last_ts=0
+    SESSION_REASON=
+    SESSION_START=0
+    SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=
+    SESSION_STARTED_AT=
+    SESSION_COMMANDS=0
+    SESSION_KEYSTROKES=0
+    SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=-1
+    ATTACKER_IP=unknown
+    : >> "$logfile"
+    while true
+    do
+        total=$(wc -l < "$logfile" | tr -d '[:space:]')
+        if [ "$total" -gt "$seen" ]
+        then
+            while IFS= read -r line
+            do
+                case "$line" in
+                    *"Attacker connected:"*)
+                        note_attacker_ip "$line"
+                        if [ -z "$SESSION_CONNECTED_AT" ]
+                        then
+                            SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+                            SESSION_STARTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+                            SESSION_START=$(date +%s)
+                        fi
+                        ;;
+                    *"Container locked to "*|*"trying to authenticate"*|*"[Auth] Attacker:"*|*"Auto Access] Attacker:"*)
+                        note_attacker_ip "$line"
+                        ;;
+                    *"line from reader:"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command:"*)
+                        SESSION_COMMANDS=$((SESSION_COMMANDS + 1))
+                        ;;
+                    *"Attacker Keystroke:"*)
+                        SESSION_KEYSTROKES=$((SESSION_KEYSTROKES + 1))
+                        ;;
+                esac
+                event=$(classify_mitm_line "$line")
+                if [ "$event" = "logout" ]
+                then
+                    if [ "$in_session" -eq 1 ]
+                    then
+                        SESSION_REASON=logout
+                        return 0
+                    fi
+                    # closed before any lock or shell: nothing is dirty, keep listening
+                    SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=
+                    SESSION_STARTED_AT=
+                    SESSION_START=0
+                    SESSION_COMMANDS=0
+                    SESSION_KEYSTROKES=0
+                    SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=-1
+                    ATTACKER_IP=unknown
+                fi
+                if [ "$event" = "activity" ]
+                then
+                    now=$(date +%s)
+                    if [ "$in_session" -eq 0 ]
+                    then
+                        in_session=1
+                        start_ts=$now
+                        if [ -z "$SESSION_CONNECTED_AT" ]
+                        then
+                            SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+                            SESSION_STARTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+                            SESSION_START=$now
+                        fi
+                        echo "session started" >&2
+                    fi
+                    if [ "$SESSION_COMMANDS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -lt 0 ]
+                    then
+                        SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=$((now - start_ts))
+                    fi
+                    last_ts=$now
+                fi
+            done < <(awk -v start=$((seen + 1)) -v end="$total" 'NR >= start && NR <= end' "$logfile")
+            seen=$total
+        fi
+        if [ "$in_session" -eq 1 ]
+        then
+            now=$(date +%s)
+            if [ $((now - start_ts)) -ge "$MAX_SESSION" ]
+            then
+                SESSION_REASON=timeout
+                return 0
+            fi
+            if [ $((now - last_ts)) -ge "$IDLE_LIMIT" ]
+            then
+                SESSION_REASON=idle
+                return 0
+            fi
+        fi
+        sleep 2
+    done
+}
+
+# one record per attack, copied into the saved session folder
+write_session_stats() {
+    local length="$1"
+    local why="$2"
+    local first=none
+    if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+    then
+        first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+    fi
+    cat > "$live/session.stats" << EOF
+honeypot=$name
+public_ip=$PUBLIC_IP
+started_at=$SESSION_STARTED_AT
+ended_at=$SESSION_ENDED_AT
+config=$(config_now)
+ascii=$(config_text)
+reason=$why
+attacker_ip=$ATTACKER_IP
+session_seconds=$length
+commands=$SESSION_COMMANDS
+keystrokes=$SESSION_KEYSTROKES
+seconds_to_first_command=$first
+EOF
+}
+
+kick_attacker() {
+    lxc exec "$name" -- pkill sshd || true
+}
+
+run_one() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local live reason ip left_at
+    lookup "$name"
+    live="$DATA/live/$name"
+    mkdir -p "$live"
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        chown aces:aces "$live" || true
+    fi
+    echo "lifecycle $name"
+    # save the finished session before the next restore wipes the container
+    reason=previous
+    while true
+    do
+        if [ -n "$reason" ]
+        then
+            archive_session "$reason"
+        fi
+        clear_session_files
+        if ! ./recycling_script.sh "$name" "${name}-mitm"
+        then
+            echo "recycle failed for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        ip=$(container_ip "$name")
+        if [ -z "$ip" ]
+        then
+            echo "no ip for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        if ! sync_mitm_target "$ip"
+        then
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        start_mitm
+        if ! mitm_listening
+        then
+            echo "mitm for $name did not start, retrying"
+            if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+            then
+                tail -n 20 "$live/mitm.log" >&2
+            fi
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        echo "waiting for attacker on $name"
+        watch_session
+        reason=$SESSION_REASON
+        SESSION_ENDED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+        left_at=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        echo "session ended: $reason"
+        length=0
+        if [ "$SESSION_START" -gt 0 ]
+        then
+            length=$(( $(date +%s) - SESSION_START ))
+        fi
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout) why="attacker left" ;;
+            idle) why="idle timeout" ;;
+            timeout) why="session timeout" ;;
+            *) why=$reason ;;
+        esac
+        first=none
+        if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+        then
+            first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+        fi
+        left=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout|idle|timeout)
+                write_session_stats "$length" "$why"
+                ;;
+        esac
+        case "$reason" in
+            idle|timeout)
+                kick_attacker
+                sleep 1
+                ;;
+            logout)
+                ;;
+            *)
+                echo "watcher stopped, recycling"
+                reason=error
+                ;;
+        esac
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        sleep 1
+    done
+}
+
+start_all() {
+    local root name
+    root=$(pwd)
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        env -u STY screen -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        screen_do -dmS "$name" bash -c "cd '$root' && exec ./run-one.sh '$name'"
+        echo "started $name"
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+}
+
+main() {
+    if [ "${1:-}" = "--all" ]
+    then
+        start_all
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]
+    then
+        echo "usage: $0 <container name> | $0 --all" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    # a failed command must not end the screen. start the honeypot again.
+    while true
+    do
+        (
+            run_one "$1"
+        ) || echo "lifecycle $1 stopped, starting again"
+        sleep 5
+    done
+}
+
+if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]
+then
+    main "$@"
+fi
