+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# one slack summary for the last 24 hours. called by daily_summary.sh.
+
+import os
+import re
+from collections import Counter
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DATA = Path(os.environ.get("HONEYPOT_DATA", "/home/aces/data"))
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+LABELS = {
+    "1": "1 control, no ascii",
+    "2": "2 25% ascii",
+    "3": "3 50% ascii",
+    "4": "4 75% ascii",
+    "5": "5 100% ascii",
+}
+
+
+def clock(dt):
+    hour = dt.strftime("%I").lstrip("0") or "12"
+    return dt.strftime(f"%Y-%m-%d {hour}:%M%p").lower()
+
+
+def table(headers, rows):
+    cols = list(zip(*([headers] + rows)))
+    widths = [max(len(str(cell)) for cell in col) for col in cols]
+
+    def line(row, fill=" "):
+        parts = []
+        for cell, width in zip(row, widths):
+            text = str(cell)
+            if fill != " ":
+                text = fill * width
+            parts.append(text.ljust(width))
+        return " │ ".join(parts)
+
+    out = [line(headers), line(headers, "─")]
+    for row in rows:
+        out.append(line(row))
+    return "\n".join(out)
+
+
+def parse_stats(path):
+    info = {}
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return info
+    for raw in path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
+        if "=" not in raw:
+            continue
+        key, value = raw.split("=", 1)
+        info[key.strip()] = value.strip()
+    return info
+
+
+def folder_time(name):
+    # 20261028T175632-hp1 is eastern. a trailing z on the stamp is utc.
+    stamp, hp = name.rsplit("-", 1)
+    utc = stamp.endswith("Z")
+    stamp = stamp[:-1] if utc else stamp
+    dt = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
+    if utc:
+        epoch = (dt - datetime(1970, 1, 1)).total_seconds()
+        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(epoch)
+    return dt, hp
+
+
+def load_honeypots():
+    rows = []
+    csv_path = ROOT / "honeypots.csv"
+    for raw in csv_path.read_text().splitlines()[1:]:
+        parts = raw.split(",")
+        if len(parts) < 3 or not parts[0]:
+            continue
+        rows.append((parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip(), parts[2].strip()))
+    return rows
+
+
+def log_time(line):
+    match = re.match(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})", line)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    return datetime.strptime(match.group(1), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+
+def attacker_ip(text):
+    found = "unknown"
+    for match in re.findall(r"Attacker connected:\s*([0-9.]+)", text):
+        if match.startswith("172.20.") or match in ("0.0.0.0", "127.0.0.1"):
+            continue
+        found = match
+    return found
+
+
+def main():
+    end = datetime.now()
+    start = end - timedelta(hours=24)
+    honeypots = load_honeypots()
+    names = [row[0] for row in honeypots]
+    public = {row[0]: row[1] for row in honeypots}
+
+    attacks = []
+    logs = DATA / "logs"
+    if logs.is_dir():
+        for folder in logs.iterdir():
+            if not re.match(r"\d{8}T\d{6}Z?-", folder.name):
+                continue
+            try:
+                when, hp = folder_time(folder.name)
+            except ValueError:
+                continue
+            if when < start or when >= end:
+                continue
+            stats = parse_stats(folder / "session.stats")
+            if not stats and not (folder / "mitm.log").is_file():
+                continue
+            ip = stats.get("attacker_ip") or "unknown"
+            if ip == "unknown" and (folder / "mitm.log").is_file():
+                ip = attacker_ip((folder / "mitm.log").read_text(errors="replace"))
+            attacks.append({
+                "hp": stats.get("honeypot", hp),
+                "ip": ip,
+                "config": stats.get("config", "unknown"),
+                "reason": stats.get("reason", "unknown"),
+                "seconds": stats.get("session_seconds", ""),
+                "commands": stats.get("commands", "0"),
+                "keystrokes": stats.get("keystrokes", "0"),
+                "open": False,
+            })
+
+    open_now = []
+    for name, ip_pub, _port in honeypots:
+        log_path = logs / f"{name}.lifecycle.log"
+        if not log_path.is_file():
+            continue
+        last = None
+        started = None
+        for raw in log_path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
+            if re.search(r"session ended|waiting for attacker|recycle failed|did not start|no ip for", raw):
+                last = "closed"
+            elif "session started" in raw:
+                last = "open"
+                started = log_time(raw)
+        if last != "open":
+            continue
+        if started is not None and (started < start or started >= end):
+            continue
+        live = DATA / "live" / name
+        ip = "unknown"
+        mitm = live / "mitm.log"
+        if mitm.is_file():
+            ip = attacker_ip(mitm.read_text(errors="replace"))
+        config = "unknown"
+        if (live / "config").is_file():
+            digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", (live / "config").read_text(errors="replace"))
+            if digits:
+                config = digits
+        item = {
+            "hp": name,
+            "ip": ip,
+            "config": config,
+            "reason": "still open",
+            "seconds": "",
+            "commands": "0",
+            "keystrokes": "0",
+            "open": True,
+        }
+        attacks.append(item)
+        open_now.append(f"{name} ({ip_pub}) from {ip}")
+
+    by_ip = Counter(item["ip"] for item in attacks)
+    by_hp = Counter(item["hp"] for item in attacks)
+    by_reason = Counter(item["reason"] for item in attacks)
+    reached = Counter(item["config"] for item in attacks)
+
+    deployed = Counter()
+    for name in names:
+        log_path = logs / f"{name}.lifecycle.log"
+        if not log_path.is_file():
+            continue
+        for raw in log_path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
+            match = re.search(r"selected configuration:\s*(\d+)", raw)
+            if not match:
+                continue
+            when = log_time(raw)
+            if when is None or when < start or when >= end:
+                continue
+            deployed[match.group(1)] += 1
+
+    def num(value):
+        try:
+            return int(value)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            return 0
+
+    commands = sum(num(item["commands"]) for item in attacks)
+    keystrokes = sum(num(item["keystrokes"]) for item in attacks)
+    lengths = [num(item["seconds"]) for item in attacks if item["seconds"] != ""]
+    average = int(round(sum(lengths) / len(lengths))) if lengths else 0
+
+    ip_rows = [(ip, str(count)) for ip, count in by_ip.most_common()]
+    if not ip_rows:
+        ip_rows = [("none", "0")]
+
+    deploy_rows = [(LABELS[key], str(deployed.get(key, 0))) for key in ("1", "2", "3", "4", "5")]
+    reached_rows = [(LABELS.get(key, key), str(count)) for key, count in sorted(reached.items(), key=lambda pair: pair[0])]
+    if not reached_rows:
+        reached_rows = [("none", "0")]
+
+    hp_rows = [(name, public.get(name, ""), str(by_hp.get(name, 0))) for name in names]
+    reason_rows = [(reason, str(count)) for reason, count in by_reason.most_common()]
+    if not reason_rows:
+        reason_rows = [("none", "0")]
+
+    lines = [
+        "*honeypot daily summary*",
+        f"{clock(start)} through {clock(end)} et",
+        "",
+        "```",
+        f"number of attackers total: {len(attacks)}",
+        f"unique attacker ips: {len(by_ip)}",
+        "",
+        "attackers by ip",
+        table(("ip address", "attackers"), ip_rows),
+        "",
+        "configurations deployed",
+        table(("configuration", "times"), deploy_rows),
+        "",
+        "configurations attackers reached",
+        table(("configuration", "attackers"), reached_rows),
+        "",
+        "attackers by honeypot",
+        table(("honeypot", "public ip", "attackers"), hp_rows),
+        "",
+        "how sessions ended",
+        table(("reason", "times"), reason_rows),
+        "",
+        f"commands: {commands}",
+        f"keystrokes: {keystrokes}",
+        f"average session: {average}s",
+        f"still open: {len(open_now)}",
+    ]
+    if open_now:
+        lines.extend(open_now)
+    lines.append("```")
+    print("\n".join(lines))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/bin/bash
+# slack only when a honeypot or the lifecycle service changes state.
+# a problem must show up on two checks in a row, so a recycle does not alert.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+export HOME=/home/aces
+export TZ=America/New_York
+export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
+
+if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]
+then
+    exec sudo -E "$0" "$@"
+fi
+
+cd "$(dirname "$0")"
+# shellcheck disable=SC1091
+. ./slack_lib.sh
+
+state="$HOME/data/health"
+mkdir -p "$state"
+changes=()
+
+consider() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local status="$2"
+    local label="$3"
+    local reported="" pending=""
+    if [ -f "$state/$key.reported" ]
+    then
+        reported=$(cat "$state/$key.reported")
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$state/$key.pending" ]
+    then
+        pending=$(cat "$state/$key.pending")
+    fi
+    printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$state/$key.pending"
+    if [ -z "$reported" ]
+    then
+        if [ "$status" = "up" ]
+        then
+            printf '%s\n' up > "$state/$key.reported"
+        else
+            printf '%s\n' unseen > "$state/$key.reported"
+        fi
+        return 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$status" = "$reported" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$status" != "$pending" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$state/$key.reported"
+    if [ "$status" = "up" ]
+    then
+        changes+=("$label is back up")
+    else
+        changes+=("$label: $status")
+    fi
+}
+
+service_status=up
+if ! systemctl is-active --quiet honeypot-lifecycle.service
+then
+    service_status="lifecycle service is not running"
+fi
+consider service "$service_status" "honeypot-lifecycle"
+
+while IFS=, read -r name public_ip port
+do
+    [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+    [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+    problems=()
+
+    info=$(lxc info "$name" 2>/dev/null || true)
+    running=$(printf '%s\n' "$info" | sed -n 's/^Status: //p' | head -n 1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
+    if [ "$running" != "running" ]
+    then
+        problems+=("container is ${running:-missing}")
+    fi
+
+    if ! ss -H -ltn | awk -v p=":${port}$" '$4 ~ p { found = 1 } END { exit !found }'
+    then
+        problems+=("mitm port ${port} is not listening")
+    fi
+
+    if ! screen -ls 2>/dev/null | grep -E "[0-9]+\\.${name}[[:space:]]" >/dev/null
+    then
+        problems+=("lifecycle screen is not running")
+    fi
+
+    log="$HOME/data/logs/${name}.lifecycle.log"
+    if [ ! -f "$log" ]
+    then
+        problems+=("lifecycle log is missing")
+    else
+        last=$(grep -E 'waiting for attacker|session started|session ended|recycle failed|did not start|no ip for' "$log" | tail -n 1 || true)
+        case "$last" in
+            *"recycle failed"*|*"did not start"*|*"no ip for"*)
+                problems+=("recycle is failing")
+                ;;
+        esac
+    fi
+
+    if [ "${#problems[@]}" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        status=up
+    else
+        status=$(printf '%s; ' "${problems[@]}")
+        status=${status%; }
+    fi
+    consider "$name" "$status" "$name ($public_ip)"
+done < ./honeypots.csv
+
+if [ "${#changes[@]}" -gt 0 ]
+then
+    message=$(printf '%s\n' "${changes[@]}")
+    printf '%s\n' "$message"
+    slack_send "$message"
+fi

+#!/bin/bash
+# one loop per honeypot. screen name is the container (hp1).
+# the mitm screen is hp1-mitm, so recycle does not kill this loop.
+# start all four with: ./lifecycle.sh --all
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd "$(dirname "$0")"
+
+# monitor.sh and this loop share /home/aces/data, even when the screen is root
+export HOME=/home/aces
+
+DATA="$HOME/data"
+MITM_CONFIG_DIR=/root/honeypots/MITM/config
+MITM_INDEX=/root/honeypots/MITM/mitm/index.js
+NAT=/root/honeypots/network/nat_mitm
+IDLE_LIMIT="${IDLE_SECONDS:-60}"
+MAX_SESSION="${MAX_SECONDS:-300}"
+
+as_root() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        "$@"
+    else
+        sudo "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+# STY is set inside a screen session. a screen command then quits this loop
+# instead of the mitm session, so every screen command drops STY first.
+screen_do() {
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        env -u STY screen "$@"
+    else
+        sudo env -u STY screen "$@"
+    fi
+}
+
+slack() {
+    local text="$1"
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ] && [ -f "$HOME/data/slack.env" ]
+    then
+        # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+        . "$HOME/data/slack.env"
+    fi
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    text=${text//$'\n'/\\n}
+    curl -sS -m 10 -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
+        --data "{\"text\":\"${text}\"}" \
+        "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" >/dev/null || true
+}
+
+config_now() {
+    local config=unknown
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        config=$(tr -cd '0-9' < "$live/config")
+    fi
+    printf '%s\n' "$config"
+}
+
+# 1 is the empty control. 2 through 5 are the ascii drawings.
+config_text() {
+    case "$(config_now)" in
+        1) printf '%s\n' "1 (control, no ascii)" ;;
+        2) printf '%s\n' "2 (25% ascii)" ;;
+        3) printf '%s\n' "3 (50% ascii)" ;;
+        4) printf '%s\n' "4 (75% ascii)" ;;
+        5) printf '%s\n' "5 (100% ascii)" ;;
+        *) printf '%s\n' "unknown" ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+# logout ends the attack. activity means a shell is open or the attacker typed.
+classify_mitm_line() {
+    case "$1" in
+        *"[Connection] Attacker closed connection"*|*"Attacker ended the shell"*|*"Honeypot ended shell"*|*"OpenSSH server ended connection"*|*"Client error"*)
+            printf '%s\n' logout
+            ;;
+        *"Container locked"*|*"Opened shell"*|*"Shell opened"*|*"shell opened"*|*"inside container"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command"*|*"Attacker Keystroke"*|*"line from reader"*)
+            printf '%s\n' activity
+            ;;
+    esac
+    return 0
+}
+
+# the attacker address is on the connect and auth lines, not the container address
+note_attacker_ip() {
+    local found
+    found=$(printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -oE '([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}' || true)
+    found=${found%%$'\n'*}
+    if [ -z "$found" ] || [ "$found" = "0.0.0.0" ] || [ "$found" = "127.0.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "172.20.0.1" ] || [ "$found" = "$PUBLIC_IP" ]
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    case "$found" in
+        172.20.*)
+            return 0
+            ;;
+    esac
+    ATTACKER_IP=$found
+}
+
+lookup() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local line
+    line=$(awk -F, -v n="$name" 'NR > 1 && $1 == n { print; exit }' ./honeypots.csv)
+    if [ -z "$line" ]
+    then
+        echo "unknown honeypot: $name" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    PUBLIC_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
+    MITM_PORT=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
+}
+
+container_ip() {
+    lxc list "$1" -c 4 --format csv 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' || true
+}
+
+session_saved() {
+    [ -s "$live/mitm.log" ] && return 0
+    local d
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+csv_field() {
+    local value="${1//\"/\"\"}"
+    printf '"%s"' "$value"
+}
+
+stats_value() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local stats_file="$2"
+    awk -F= -v key="$key" '
+        $1 == key {
+            sub(/^[^=]*=/, "")
+            print
+            exit
+        }
+    ' "$stats_file"
+}
+
+append_session_csv() {
+    local dest="$1"
+    local stats_file="$dest/session.stats"
+    local csv="$DATA/${name}.lifecycle.csv"
+    local session_id started_at ended_at honeypot public_ip config ascii reason
+    local attacker_ip session_seconds commands keystrokes first_command
+
+    [ -f "$stats_file" ] || return 0
+    session_id=${dest##*/}
+    started_at=$(stats_value started_at "$stats_file")
+    ended_at=$(stats_value ended_at "$stats_file")
+    # Older archived stats do not include timestamps and cannot form a full row.
+    [ -n "$started_at" ] && [ -n "$ended_at" ] || return 0
+
+    if [ -s "$csv" ] && awk -F, -v id="$session_id" '
+        NR > 1 && ($1 == id || $1 == "\"" id "\"") { found = 1 }
+        END { exit !found }
+    ' "$csv"
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+
+    if [ ! -s "$csv" ]
+    then
+        printf '%s\n' 'session_id,honeypot,started_at,ended_at,session_status,public_ip,config,ascii,reason,attacker_ip,session_seconds,commands,keystrokes,seconds_to_first_command' > "$csv"
+    fi
+
+    honeypot=$(stats_value honeypot "$stats_file")
+    public_ip=$(stats_value public_ip "$stats_file")
+    config=$(stats_value config "$stats_file")
+    ascii=$(stats_value ascii "$stats_file")
+    reason=$(stats_value reason "$stats_file")
+    attacker_ip=$(stats_value attacker_ip "$stats_file")
+    session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$stats_file")
+    commands=$(stats_value commands "$stats_file")
+    keystrokes=$(stats_value keystrokes "$stats_file")
+    first_command=$(stats_value seconds_to_first_command "$stats_file")
+    first_command=${first_command%s}
+    [ "$first_command" != none ] || first_command=
+
+    {
+        csv_field "$session_id"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$honeypot"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$started_at"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$ended_at"; printf ','
+        csv_field completed; printf ','
+        csv_field "$public_ip"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$config"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$ascii"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$reason"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$attacker_ip"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$session_seconds"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$commands"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$keystrokes"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$first_command"; printf '\n'
+    } >> "$csv"
+}
+
+archive_session() {
+    local reason="$1"
+    local label stamp dest d
+    if ! session_saved
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+    case "$reason" in
+        logout) label="attacker left" ;;
+        idle) label="idle timeout" ;;
+        timeout) label="session timeout" ;;
+        *) label="$reason" ;;
+    esac
+    stamp=$(TZ=America/New_York date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
+    dest="$DATA/logs/${stamp}-${name}"
+    mkdir -p "$dest"
+    printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$dest/leave_reason"
+    if [ -f "$live/config" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/config" "$dest/config"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/mitm.log" "$dest/mitm.log"
+    fi
+    if [ -f "$live/session.stats" ]
+    then
+        cp "$live/session.stats" "$dest/session.stats"
+    fi
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        if [ -d "$live/$d" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$live/$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]
+        then
+            mkdir -p "$dest/$d"
+            cp -a "$live/$d"/. "$dest/$d/"
+        fi
+    done
+    append_session_csv "$dest"
+    echo "saved $dest ($label)"
+}
+
+clear_session_files() {
+    local d
+    rm -f "$live/mitm.log" "$live/session.stats"
+    for d in logins login_attempts sessions
+    do
+        rm -rf "$live/$d"
+        mkdir -p "$live/$d"
+    done
+}
+
+sync_mitm_target() {
+    local ip="$1"
+    local cfg="$MITM_CONFIG_DIR/${name}.js"
+    local current
+    if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]
+    then
+        echo "missing $cfg" >&2
+        return 1
+    fi
+    mkdir -p "$live/logins" "$live/login_attempts" "$live/sessions"
+    current=$(as_root grep -oE "ipAddress[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*['\"][0-9.]+" "$cfg" | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$' || true)
+    replace_js_string streamOutput "$live/sessions" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string loginAttempts "$live/login_attempts" "$cfg"
+    replace_js_string logins "$live/logins" "$cfg"
+    if [ "$current" != "$ip" ]
+    then
+        replace_js_string ipAddress "$ip" "$cfg"
+        echo "container ip changed to $ip, updating nat"
+        as_root "$NAT" "$PUBLIC_IP" "$ip" "$MITM_PORT"
+    fi
+}
+
+# replace the quoted value of one js key and leave the rest of the line alone
+replace_js_string() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local value="$2"
+    local cfg="$3"
+    local sq="'"
+    local quoted="[${sq}\"][^${sq}\"]*[${sq}\"]"
+    as_root sed -i -E "s|(${key}[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)${quoted}|\\1${sq}${value}${sq}|" "$cfg"
+}
+
+start_mitm() {
+    local _
+    : > "$live/mitm.log"
+    screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    # wait for the old node process to release the port before starting a new one
+    for _ in $(seq 1 20)
+    do
+        if ! ss -ltn "sport = :$MITM_PORT" | grep -q LISTEN
+        then
+            break
+        fi
+        sleep 0.5
+    done
+    screen_do -dmS "${name}-mitm" bash -c "cd '$MITM_CONFIG_DIR' && node '$MITM_INDEX' '${name}.js' 2>&1 | tee -a '$live/mitm.log'"
+}
+
+mitm_listening() {
+    local _
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30)
+    do
+        if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ] && grep -q "listening on" "$live/mitm.log"
+        then
+            return 0
+        fi
+        sleep 1
+    done
+    return 1
+}
+
+# sets SESSION_REASON, SESSION_START, SESSION_CONNECTED_AT, SESSION_COMMANDS, SESSION_KEYSTROKES, SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND, ATTACKER_IP
+watch_session() {
+    local logfile="$live/mitm.log"
+    local seen=0 total now line event
+    local in_session=0 start_ts=0 last_ts=0
+    SESSION_REASON=
+    SESSION_START=0
+    SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=
+    SESSION_STARTED_AT=
+    SESSION_COMMANDS=0
+    SESSION_KEYSTROKES=0
+    SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=-1
+    ATTACKER_IP=unknown
+    : >> "$logfile"
+    while true
+    do
+        total=$(wc -l < "$logfile" | tr -d '[:space:]')
+        if [ "$total" -gt "$seen" ]
+        then
+            while IFS= read -r line
+            do
+                case "$line" in
+                    *"Attacker connected:"*)
+                        note_attacker_ip "$line"
+                        if [ -z "$SESSION_CONNECTED_AT" ]
+                        then
+                            SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+                            SESSION_STARTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+                            SESSION_START=$(date +%s)
+                        fi
+                        ;;
+                    *"Container locked to "*|*"trying to authenticate"*|*"[Auth] Attacker:"*|*"Auto Access] Attacker:"*)
+                        note_attacker_ip "$line"
+                        ;;
+                    *"line from reader:"*|*"Noninteractive mode attacker command:"*)
+                        SESSION_COMMANDS=$((SESSION_COMMANDS + 1))
+                        ;;
+                    *"Attacker Keystroke:"*)
+                        SESSION_KEYSTROKES=$((SESSION_KEYSTROKES + 1))
+                        ;;
+                esac
+                event=$(classify_mitm_line "$line")
+                if [ "$event" = "logout" ]
+                then
+                    if [ "$in_session" -eq 1 ]
+                    then
+                        SESSION_REASON=logout
+                        return 0
+                    fi
+                    # closed before any lock or shell: nothing is dirty, keep listening
+                    SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=
+                    SESSION_STARTED_AT=
+                    SESSION_START=0
+                    SESSION_COMMANDS=0
+                    SESSION_KEYSTROKES=0
+                    SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=-1
+                    ATTACKER_IP=unknown
+                fi
+                if [ "$event" = "activity" ]
+                then
+                    now=$(date +%s)
+                    if [ "$in_session" -eq 0 ]
+                    then
+                        in_session=1
+                        start_ts=$now
+                        if [ -z "$SESSION_CONNECTED_AT" ]
+                        then
+                            SESSION_CONNECTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+                            SESSION_STARTED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+                            SESSION_START=$now
+                        fi
+                        echo "session started" >&2
+                    fi
+                    if [ "$SESSION_COMMANDS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -lt 0 ]
+                    then
+                        SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND=$((now - start_ts))
+                    fi
+                    last_ts=$now
+                fi
+            done < <(awk -v start=$((seen + 1)) -v end="$total" 'NR >= start && NR <= end' "$logfile")
+            seen=$total
+        fi
+        if [ "$in_session" -eq 1 ]
+        then
+            now=$(date +%s)
+            if [ $((now - start_ts)) -ge "$MAX_SESSION" ]
+            then
+                SESSION_REASON=timeout
+                return 0
+            fi
+            if [ $((now - last_ts)) -ge "$IDLE_LIMIT" ]
+            then
+                SESSION_REASON=idle
+                return 0
+            fi
+        fi
+        sleep 2
+    done
+}
+
+# one record per attack, copied into the saved session folder
+write_session_stats() {
+    local length="$1"
+    local why="$2"
+    local first=none
+    if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+    then
+        first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+    fi
+    cat > "$live/session.stats" << EOF
+honeypot=$name
+public_ip=$PUBLIC_IP
+started_at=$SESSION_STARTED_AT
+ended_at=$SESSION_ENDED_AT
+config=$(config_now)
+ascii=$(config_text)
+reason=$why
+attacker_ip=$ATTACKER_IP
+session_seconds=$length
+commands=$SESSION_COMMANDS
+keystrokes=$SESSION_KEYSTROKES
+seconds_to_first_command=$first
+EOF
+}
+
+kick_attacker() {
+    lxc exec "$name" -- pkill sshd || true
+}
+
+run_one() {
+    local name="$1"
+    local live reason ip left_at
+    lookup "$name"
+    live="$DATA/live/$name"
+    mkdir -p "$live"
+    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        chown aces:aces "$live" || true
+    fi
+    echo "lifecycle $name"
+    # save the finished session before the next restore wipes the container
+    reason=previous
+    while true
+    do
+        if [ -n "$reason" ]
+        then
+            archive_session "$reason"
+        fi
+        clear_session_files
+        if ! ./recycling_script.sh "$name" "${name}-mitm"
+        then
+            echo "recycle failed for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        ip=$(container_ip "$name")
+        if [ -z "$ip" ]
+        then
+            echo "no ip for $name, retrying"
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        if ! sync_mitm_target "$ip"
+        then
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        start_mitm
+        if ! mitm_listening
+        then
+            echo "mitm for $name did not start, retrying"
+            if [ -f "$live/mitm.log" ]
+            then
+                tail -n 20 "$live/mitm.log" >&2
+            fi
+            reason=
+            sleep 5
+            continue
+        fi
+        echo "waiting for attacker on $name"
+        watch_session
+        reason=$SESSION_REASON
+        SESSION_ENDED_AT=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+        left_at=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        echo "session ended: $reason"
+        length=0
+        if [ "$SESSION_START" -gt 0 ]
+        then
+            length=$(( $(date +%s) - SESSION_START ))
+        fi
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout) why="attacker left" ;;
+            idle) why="idle timeout" ;;
+            timeout) why="session timeout" ;;
+            *) why=$reason ;;
+        esac
+        first=none
+        if [ "$SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND" -ge 0 ]
+        then
+            first="${SESSION_FIRST_COMMAND}s"
+        fi
+        left=$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z')
+        case "$reason" in
+            logout|idle|timeout)
+                write_session_stats "$length" "$why"
+            idle|timeout)
+                kick_attacker
+                sleep 1
+                ;;
+            logout)
+                ;;
+            *)
+                echo "watcher stopped, recycling"
+                reason=error
+                ;;
+        esac
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        sleep 1
+    done
+}
+
+start_all() {
+    local root name
+    root=$(pwd)
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        env -u STY screen -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "$name" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+        screen_do -S "${name}-mitm" -X quit 2>/dev/null || true
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+    while IFS=, read -r name _ _
+    do
+        [ -z "$name" ] && continue
+        [ "$name" = "name" ] && continue
+        screen_do -dmS "$name" bash -c "cd '$root' && exec ./run-one.sh '$name'"
+        echo "started $name"
+    done < ./honeypots.csv
+}
+
+main() {
+    if [ "${1:-}" = "--all" ]
+    then
+        start_all
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]
+    then
+        echo "usage: $0 <container name> | $0 --all" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    # a failed command must not end the screen. start the honeypot again.
+    while true
+    do
+        (
+            run_one "$1"
+        ) || echo "lifecycle $1 stopped, starting again"
+        sleep 5
+    done
+}
+
+if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]
+then
+    main "$@"
+fi

+#!/bin/bash
+# post one message. webhook is $HOME/data/slack.env
+
+slack_send() {
+    local text="$1"
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME}/data/slack.env" ]
+    then
+        # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+        . "${HOME}/data/slack.env"
+    fi
+    if [ -z "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}" ]
+    then
+        echo "no slack webhook" >&2
+        return 0
+    fi
+    local payload
+    payload=$(printf '%s' "$text" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps({"text": sys.stdin.read()}))')
+    curl -sS -m 15 -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
+        --data "$payload" \
+        "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" >/dev/null || echo "slack post failed" >&2
+}

+csv_field() {
+    local value="${1//\"/\"\"}"
+    printf '"%s"' "$value"
+}
+
+stats_value() {
+    local key="$1"
+    local stats_file="$2"
+    awk -F= -v key="$key" '
+        $1 == key {
+            sub(/^[^=]*=/, "")
+            print
+            exit
+        }
+    ' "$stats_file"
+}
+
+append_session_csv() {
+    local dest="$1"
+    local stats_file="$dest/session.stats"
+    local csv="$DATA/${name}.lifecycle.csv"
+    local session_id started_at ended_at honeypot public_ip config ascii reason
+    local attacker_ip session_seconds commands keystrokes first_command
+
+    [ -f "$stats_file" ] || return 0
+    session_id=${dest##*/}
+    started_at=$(stats_value started_at "$stats_file")
+    ended_at=$(stats_value ended_at "$stats_file")
+    # Older archived stats do not include timestamps and cannot form a full row.
+    [ -n "$started_at" ] && [ -n "$ended_at" ] || return 0
+
+    if [ -s "$csv" ] && awk -F, -v id="$session_id" '
+        NR > 1 && ($1 == id || $1 == "\"" id "\"") { found = 1 }
+        END { exit !found }
+    ' "$csv"
+    then
+        return 0
+    fi
+
+    if [ ! -s "$csv" ]
+    then
+        printf '%s\n' 'session_id,honeypot,started_at,ended_at,session_status,public_ip,config,ascii,reason,attacker_ip,session_seconds,commands,keystrokes,seconds_to_first_command' > "$csv"
+    fi
+
+    honeypot=$(stats_value honeypot "$stats_file")
+    public_ip=$(stats_value public_ip "$stats_file")
+    config=$(stats_value config "$stats_file")
+    ascii=$(stats_value ascii "$stats_file")
+    reason=$(stats_value reason "$stats_file")
+    attacker_ip=$(stats_value attacker_ip "$stats_file")
+    session_seconds=$(stats_value session_seconds "$stats_file")
+    commands=$(stats_value commands "$stats_file")
+    keystrokes=$(stats_value keystrokes "$stats_file")
+    first_command=$(stats_value seconds_to_first_command "$stats_file")
+    first_command=${first_command%s}
+    [ "$first_command" != none ] || first_command=
+
+    {
+        csv_field "$session_id"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$honeypot"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$started_at"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$ended_at"; printf ','
+        csv_field completed; printf ','
+        csv_field "$public_ip"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$config"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$ascii"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$reason"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$attacker_ip"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$session_seconds"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$commands"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$keystrokes"; printf ','
+        csv_field "$first_command"; printf '\n'
+    } >> "$csv"

-# HACS200-falLACY-Honeypot-Project
+# HACS200 Fallacy Honeypot Project
+
+This project deploys and operates SSH honeypots to observe and study attacker
+behavior in a controlled environment. Each honeypot runs in an Ubuntu LXD
+container and is presented as a fictional bank environment. SSH activity is
+handled by a separate MITM service, while the lifecycle scripts track sessions
+and preserve their logs for later analysis.
+
+## What it does
+
+- Runs four honeypot containers (`hp1`–`hp4`), with public addresses and MITM
+  ports listed in [`honeypots.csv`](./honeypots.csv).
+- Creates a clean container snapshot with SSH enabled and generated fictional
+  bank files. Each session starts from this snapshot so one visitor's changes
+  do not persist into the next session.
+- Randomly selects one of five configurations for each cycle: a no-art control
+  or a terminal-art banner shown at 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% coverage.
+- Monitors MITM output to detect when a visitor enters or leaves, count commands
+  and keystrokes, record the visitor IP when available, and end idle or
+  overlong sessions.
+- Records SSH login and connection events and archives session data with a
+  human-readable leave reason (`attacker left`, `idle timeout`, or
+  `session timeout`).
+
+## Components
+
+- [`create_honeypot.sh`](./create_honeypot.sh) provisions a container, runs
+  shared and honeypot setup, and saves the clean snapshot.
+- [`common_setup.sh`](./common_setup.sh) installs and configures SSH and the
+  fictional hostname.
+- [`honey_setup.sh`](./honey_setup.sh) generates the fictional bank files and
+  logs placed inside each container.
+- [`recycling_script.sh`](./recycling_script.sh) restores a clean snapshot,
+  applies a configuration, checks SSH readiness, and starts the MITM service.
+- [`lifecycle.sh`](./lifecycle.sh) runs the session loop, monitors MITM output,
+  and archives session records.
+- [`monitor.sh`](./monitor.sh) records SSH authentication, disconnect, and
+  container health events.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- Linux host with LXD (`lxc`) configured and permission to manage containers.
+- `screen`, `sudo`, and the usual shell utilities used by the scripts.
+- The MITM Node.js service and its per-container configurations, expected by
+  default under `/root/honeypots/MITM/`.
+- The host NAT helper, expected by default at
+  `/root/honeypots/network/nat_mitm`.
+- Network and firewall rules appropriate for an authorized, isolated research
+  deployment.
+
+The MITM service and NAT helper are external dependencies; they are not included
+in this repository. `recycling_script.sh` supports overriding the MITM paths
+with `MITM_INDEX`, `MITM_CONFIG_DIR`, and `MITM_CONFIG`.
+
+## Setup and operation
+
+From the project directory, create each container once:
+
+```bash
+./create_honeypot.sh hp1
+./create_honeypot.sh hp2
+./create_honeypot.sh hp3
+./create_honeypot.sh hp4
+```
+
+Then start lifecycle loops for all honeypots:
+
+```bash
+./lifecycle.sh --all
+```
+
+Each loop requires the matching MITM config (for example, `hp1.js`) and the
+external host networking/NAT setup to be ready. To run one honeypot instead,
+use `./lifecycle.sh hp1`.
+
+## Collected data
+
+Live per-container data is written under `~/data/live/<container>/`. Archived
+sessions are saved under `~/data/logs/`, including the MITM log, session
+statistics, leave reason, configuration, and any available login/session
+records. The lifecycle loop can also send session-start and session-end
